book.name: 1 Kolinita
book.title: 1 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta ꞌaigeda Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Tasigwao, wanuwatuhu tutaina mwalo Yehoba tetelina yaꞌeweyawa ma yahepwaileya ꞌoimiya, geya ꞌigu gwae waiwaiyega, gide ꞌabehega taugu tosanapu moisa.
Ta hesi nuwanuwagu ma Yesu Kelisomo weyahina yada guguya ꞌoimiya tauna siloheꞌamasiya kelose ꞌoina.
Coinega ꞌigu latuma ꞌoimiya gide toweꞌa, maꞌigu dedela ta maꞌigu ꞌateyoho.
Ma wete ꞌigu guguya ꞌoimiya geya gwae waiwaidi nuwana sanapu ꞌoidiyega, ta hesi Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina waiwaiyega.
Coinega ꞌigu guguyaina wahesagoheya ma wada hemisae ꞌabehega geya tomota ꞌidi sanapu ꞌoinega, ta hesi Yehoba ꞌina waiwaiyega.
Sanapu moisa Yehoba ꞌoinega yahehepwaile tohemisa paꞌalidi ꞌoidiya, ma hesi geya gogo gabulena bewa ꞌana sanapu bo toloinao bewa tuwa ꞌidi sanapu, taudi simiyamiya tuta toꞌutoꞌupana tuwa.
Ma hesi sanapuina Yehoba ꞌoinega mwalo dahwadahwaina, ta bewa tuwa ꞌiꞌabilatuheya, weyahina muliyetega ma gogo gabulena ꞌihemasaleheya, nugeta nuwanuwana ma ꞌida ꞌebeyaliyayaina ꞌida ꞌebwaegita.
Ta gogo gabulena bewa ꞌana toloinao sanapuina geya sisanasanapu, ma ꞌeguma nuwana sida sanapu nugeteya, sahena ꞌida Bada galewega siloloheꞌamasi kelose ꞌoina.
Ta hesi ꞌida yaliyayaina weyahina Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina hepwaila ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Sahena tagwaegwae Yehoba ꞌana tohelauwao ꞌadi lema bwebweꞌana hedadena ꞌiꞌatububuya. Geya ꞌeta loheya ꞌida ꞌiteya bo ꞌihesagohe ma ꞌida nuwasabwalena lemaina, weyahina bwebweꞌana hedada.”

content: Ta hesi Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌoinega Yehoba sanapuina ꞌiꞌabilatuheya ꞌoida, weyahina Yehoba Yaluyaluwana ginaula mabwaiyana ꞌisanapudiya. Coinega Yehoba ꞌina nuwatuhu dahwadahwaidi wete ꞌisanapudiya.

Tanuwatuhuyahi tauda tomota weyahida, ꞌeguma taiya loheya maꞌina nuwatuhu dahwadahwaina loheyaina tauna yaluyaluwana ꞌisanasanapu hile. Gidemusa wete Yehoba Yaluyaluwana ꞌiboinamo ꞌina nuwatuhu ꞌisanasanapu hile.
Yehoba Yaluyaluwana geya gogo gabulena yaluyaluwadi gide, ma hesi Yehoba ꞌiꞌebwaegita Yaluyaluwanaina, ꞌoinega tanuwa sabwalena ꞌina helauwedi taudi ꞌiheguyaiyediya.

Coinega ꞌida gwae, nuwana ꞌida heꞌita, geya gogo gabulena ꞌidi sanapu ꞌoinega, ta hesi Yehoba Yaluyaluwanega. Coinega taiyewedi taudi Yaluyaluwaina ꞌoidiya ꞌimiyamiya sowasowahidi ma gwaeyedi sihesagohedi ma wete sisanapudi.

Ta hesi ꞌeguma geya, geyaꞌabwa wete sisanasanapu, weyahina ꞌoidiya ꞌabehega ginaula yauyauledi tuwa. Coinega geya sowasowahidi ma ginaulaedi sisanapudi, weyahina Yehoba Yaluyaluwana geya ꞌiꞌabihenuwa sabwalenidi.
Ta hesi tauda ginaula mabwaiyadi tasanasanapudi, toꞌaha bwebweꞌana ma toꞌaha galana, ꞌoinega geya ꞌeta taiya sowasowahina ma ꞌiꞌahwa galagalaegita.

content.text: “Moisa, geya ꞌeta taiya Yehoba ꞌina nuwatuhu ꞌisanapu ma ꞌabehega ꞌida heꞌita,” ma tauda hesi Keliso ꞌina nuwatuhu ꞌoinega tanuwanuwa.
